currentDefinition.entry: first persisted BUY signal with non-null market_price
currentDefinition.exit: first persisted SELL or STOP_LOSS signal after BUY with non-null market_price
currentDefinition.completedPopulation: only plans with both qualifying BUY and later SELL/STOP_LOSS signal
currentDefinition.addReduce: preserved as events but ignored by main return formula

semanticClassification.winRateMeaning: conditional win rate among signal-path episodes that have already emitted a qualifying terminal SELL/STOP_LOSS signal
semanticClassification.censoring: OPEN episodes are right-censored and excluded; metric can change mechanically as open episodes later terminate

sizingConsequence: cannot validate PriorityScore allocation economics because allocation amount/shares do not enter the return formula
cannot validate realized capital efficiency because fills/costs/partial executions are absent
cannot treat current winRate as unbiased all-plan success probability without handling BUY-row coverage and open-episode censoring
safeUse: positive BUY-to-terminal-signal directional path analysis when positive rows exist
comparison only with explicit signal-path terminology and censoring/coverage caveats
